description: Turn an ordinary video request into a three-beat visual proposal and recommended template. Pass templateId to preserve an accepted template when changing only the aspect; omit it for a new direction. This tool does not generate images, save a project, render, or publish.

acceptedDesign.description: The design the user accepted: style, duration in seconds, audio, illustration and exclusions. Pass it on to scaffold_video_spec and hosted tools.

body.description: Accepted body copy, kept exactly as supplied.

brief.description: The user's video request in their own words. It picks the recommended template and, without a title, the working title.

cta.description: Accepted call to action, kept exactly as supplied.

templateId.description: Accepted template family to keep, for example when only the aspect changes. Omit for a new direction.

title.description: Accepted title, if the user supplied one. Omit to derive one from the brief.

name: propose_video_storyboard
title: Propose a video storyboard
